_comment: ADOPTER EXAMPLE (rc.37 · flow-plan Phase 3) — a governed change that went ALL THE WAY and then ended. It exists so the flow instruments have something real to measure: change-example is mid-flight, so on its own it yields a stage histogram and no lead time, and a report that can only ever print 'not computable' proves nothing. This one is TERMINAL (superseded by a later change), which is also why it is cheap: a terminal change ships nothing, so it carries no control plan, no passport and no receipts — the envelope gate stops re-litigating it and keeps only the record of who judged it, plus the state_history that says how it moved. Mounted by the CI dry-run as docs/governance/changes/CHG-2026-0031/. Not in the copy manifest: it is the Loom's own demonstration data, not adopter machinery.

classification.rationale: Adds the affordability disclosure to the existing limit-review letter. Personal data in scope; no model in the decision path, so medium.

_flow_note: 40 days classified → in-production, of which 12 sat in permission-to-launch waiting on approvals and 14 were actual delivery. That ratio is the entire argument of the flow plan, and until state_history existed nobody could compute it from the artifacts.
